Unknown when completion requires an unresolved spatial relation or receiver identity, or when established entry cannot be distinguished as intermediate versus completed stuffing. A boundary-mapping pass is not positive entry evidence. Unresolved source correspondence alone does not invalidate established spatial evidence, but an unresolved edited receiver identity prevents claiming insertion into a cup.
